channels.formula: 0.5 * rho * Cd_i * A_i * |v_i| * v_i per body axis
channels.note: Cd and reference area are DECLARED per hull, never measured. A declared planing multiplier multiplies the result above the Froude threshold.

channels.formula: v_surge / sqrt(g * L)
channels.note: L is the declared waterline length. The drag multiplier is a declared STEP at this number, not a smooth blend.

channels.formula: KB + BM - KG with BM = I_waterplane / V_displaced
channels.note: Computed from the declared rectangular waterplane, once, at build time. A negative GM is reported as a warning and never suppressed.

channels.formula: declared Ca on the surge axis
channels.note: A declared coefficient, not a fitted one. Linear added mass is credible below Ca = 1.0 only.

channels.formula: gain * shaped((signal - deadband) / (1 - deadband)), clamped at saturation
channels.note: The declared transfer function. Exact given the declared curve, gain and deadband; the physical truth of those declarations is a separate question.

channels.formula: same transfer function, torque units
channels.note: Bidirectional actuators centre the signal at 0.5.

channels.formula: Ct * rho_air * A_blade * v_tip^2, v_tip = omega * R
channels.note: Free-air disc model. Ct and blade area are declared. Ground effect and rotor-rotor interaction are declared unavailable.

channels.formula: |0.5 * rho_air * Cd * A * |v - v_wind| * (v - v_wind)|
channels.note: Cd and reference area are declared. The force the airframe must fight to hold station in a wind; this model has no attitude or position controller, so it is NOT a prediction of how much extra hover thrust a real drone needs.

channels.formula: p / (R * T) from the ISA troposphere
channels.note: Exact within the ISA troposphere by definition. It is the reference the recorded readings are compared against, not the real atmosphere.

channels.formula: elapsed wall clock of the loopback fetch
channels.note: A local loopback fetch. NOT a real page-load metric: no browser renders the page, so this measures the supervisor, not a user's experience.
